Actual Article Body:
The FBI arrested Abdulrahman Alfozan, a 35-year-old Saudi national and former OpenAI engineer, who allegedly planted a recording device inside the artificial intelligence company’s San Francisco office late last month.

Friday’s arrest, which was revealed by OpenAI and the Justice Department on Tuesday, is particularly concerning to the administration as it pursues global AI dominance. While analysts typically focus on China’s competition with the U.S. in the AI race, Saudi Arabia is emerging as a competitor.
